baseline.name: artifact_presence_only_v0
baseline.rule: Show a proposed action when artifact_id is present; do not check freshness, evidence gaps, data-quality hold, asset match, or lifecycle lineage.

treatment.name: evidence_aware_gate_v1
treatment.rule: Use the current frozen readiness contract: required evidence, asset match, 24-hour freshness, data-quality hold, evidence gaps, and lifecycle lineage checks.

claim_boundary: This is a frozen synthetic counterfactual policy comparison, not a historical production A/B test. It measures contract-level unsafe action exposure and lineage detection only; it does not measure LLM accuracy, real outages, factory outcomes, user behavior, latency, or business impact.
